name: Soku Ochi Happily Ever After
source:
The setting is a high school in Japan.

The protagonist "Kana" debuts in high school because she wants a boyfriend like a prince, but a boy she doesn't like at all finds out about it, and somehow, she ends up with a happy ending in the future!

Answer the choices correctly to avoid an immediate happy ending and get a prince boyfriend!

[From [url=https://origo-pkt.itch.io/fall-into-happily-ever-after]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
舞台是日本的一所高中。

主人公“加奈”怀着交到王子般男朋友的愿望，开始高中生活，却被一个自己完全不喜欢的男孩发现，结果不知为何，未来竟迎来了幸福结局！

正确回答选项，避开立刻到来的幸福结局，交到王子般的男朋友吧！

[摘自[url=https://origo-pkt.itch.io/fall-into-happily-ever-after]itch.io[/url]]
